stageNotes: Stage 1: apex https://fishingworldgc.ca returns 200; www redirects 301 with x-redirect-reason: canonical_host_redirection. Canonical = apex.

Stage 2: heavy 8-batch probe at 2026-05-13T08:19:18Z — cf-ray every batch, server: cloudflare. Honeypots /wp-* /xmlrpc /.git /phpinfo all 404 from Shopify origin (404 page = 210298 bytes). /.env got 200 (Shopify serves storefront on unknown paths). No-UA returned 403 (4515 bytes — Shopify origin filter). SQLi/XSS payloads returned 200. Verdict: cloudflare-passive — set hasWaf:false operationally per skill (no active blocking).

Stage 3: homepage HTML contains Shopify.shop = 'fishing-world-hunting.myshopify.com', cdn.shopify.com preconnect, shopify-section divs. No age-gate markup, no recaptcha/hcaptcha/turnstile script tags. needsPlaywright:false (plain Shopify HTML).

Stage 4: /collections.json returned 250 collections totaling 10367 in summed products_count (heavy cross-collection overlap). /products.json walk (9 pages × 250) yielded 2011 unique IDs. /collections/all walk yielded same 2011 unique IDs (perfect overlap proof). Site has 2011 products well under the Shopify dept-feed soft-cap; /collections/all is the minimum-cover URL.

Stage 4g: extracted 3 random products (positions 1, mid, last on page 1 of /products.json). All 3 have title, numeric price > 0, in_stock variant, valid /products/<handle> URL. Spot-check fetch of /products/burris-fullfield-3-12x42-e3-ksb-1 returned 200.

Stage 5: pagination via /products.json?limit=250&page={N} — walked pages 1-9, page 2 first handle != page 1 first handle (zero-overlap). Last page returned 11 products. HTML pagination on /collections/all uses ?page={N} with perPage=24 (Shopify theme default).

Stage 6: HTML /collections/all?sort_by=created-descending grid-item-1 = f-a-i-r-model-combi-12ga-45-70 (published 2026-05-11). Counter-control ?sort_by=title-ascending grid-item-2 = 3d-gunworks-bx-1-triple-mag-coupler (alphabetic ascending). Different first products = sort honored. Note: Shopify /products.json IGNORES sort_by per Mistake 32 quirk, but the API's natural order IS published_at-desc (proven monotonic across the 2011-product walk).

Stage 7: /products.json walk is monotonic published_at-desc across 2011 products (first 2026-05-11, last 2023-05-14). sortParam honored on HTML. Method = navigate-from-watermark (HTML sort or API natural order both yield newest-first).

Stage 8: shopify-products-walk method — endpoint /products.json, perPage 250. Count 2011 reconciles with sitemap_products_1.xml (2012 <loc> minus 1 homepage entry = 2011) and /collections/all walk (2011).
